 JDT Beat DPMM FC 2-0 In FA Cup First Semifinal Leg
 23/10/2026 11:49 PM 
 Johor Southern Tigers fb 
 KUALA LUMPUR, Oct 23 (Bernama) -- Johor Darul Ta’zim (JDT) notched up a 2-0 victory over DPMM FC in their first semi final leg of the FA Cup at Hassanal Bolkiah National Stadium , Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei, tonight.
 Striker Bergson da Silva scored JDT’s first goal in the 21st minute while Eddy Israfilov scored the second goal in the 72nd minute for a dominating victory.
 Barring an upset in the second leg semifinal on Nov 8 at Sultan Ibrahim Stadium, Iskandar Puteri, JDT looks certain to qualify for their fifth consecutive FA Cup final, having won the cup in 2016, 2022, 2023, 2024 dan 2025.
 In the other first semifinal leg match, Selangor FC beat Kuching FC 2-1 at Petaling Jaya City Council Stadium , Kelana Jaya.
 The visitors did shock Selangor FC by taking the lead in the ninth minute thanks to Ramadhan Saifullah ‘s goal, but the home team equalised in the 19th minute through Eduardo Sosa.
 Eduardo scored his second goal of the match to put his team in a comfortable 2-1 win in the 58th minute.
--> Both teams will play the second leg on Nov 8 when Kuching City FC hosts Selangor FC at Sarawak Stadium, Kuching.
